caption: The image depicts a decorative plate featuring a central scene surrounded by a floral and fruit border. The central scene shows a river with a paddlewheel steamboat traveling from left to right, emitting smoke from its smokestack. There are a few people visible on the steamboat. Behind the river, on the right side, is a large building with arched windows at the water level and another structure behind it. Small boats with people are also on the river. In the background, there are numerous trees, a hillside, and another building with columns. The sky contains several clouds. The outer border of the plate is adorned with an arrangement of flowers, leaves, and fruits, including large blossoms and round fruits that could be peaches or apples. The artwork is monochrome, appearing in shades of gray, indicating that the image is in black and white.
title: Plate - "Damn and Waterworks, Philadelphia"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
